tuning_policy.development: Feature/threshold engineering may use development datasets only.
tuning_policy.calibration: Probability/threshold calibration may use calibration datasets only after development choices are frozen.
tuning_policy.held_out_test: No threshold, feature, blocking or calibration changes may be informed by held-out outcomes.
tuning_policy.independent_benchmark_2: All Bateup 2026 Cochrane sets remain untouched until the ASySD development/calibration/test workflow is frozen.
